# GEES-1.1 Permanent Knowledge Graph & Context Protocol

## Core Directive
The AI agent must maintain an ongoing, structured graph of context across sessions, tracking architectural decisions, business logic, file relationships, and user preferences.

## Entity Map (Nodes & Edges)
1. **Projects:** 
   - `GEES-1.1` (Global Education Expert Services - International EdTech platform, React/Vite/Tailwind).
   - `SubHub`, `BoostBangla`, `Radio Bangla` (Isolated sister projects—do not cross-contaminate logic or databases).
2. **Key Integrations & Features:**
   - Multi-currency switcher (RM, BDT, USD).
   - Student CRM Pipeline & Expected Commission tracking.
   - Interactive Deadline Heatmap & Alumni Placement Insights.
3. **Engineering Standards:**
   - Security, performance, clean spacing, responsive layouts, enterprise optimization.
